summary: DRAFT for Kev to send: intro email to Kyle Cockell (pre-start steps). Kyle's address not found, so the recipient listed is Kev's review copy only; Kev adds Kyle's address and sends.
detail:
Subject:Next steps before you start at Eden

Hi Kyle,

Nick and I are glad to be talking with you about joining Eden as a recruiter in Boise. Before we settle a start date, everyone goes through a short pre-start. It is for you as much as for us: to know how you work, and to see whether Eden is the right place for you. Nothing in it is pass or fail. Because you have recruited before, we will run you on an accelerated ramp and measure how fast you get up to speed, not put you through a standard onboarding.

Here is the shape of the next ten days (proposed dates, we will confirm times):

1. **Enneagram** by Fri 23 Oct. Read the one-pager first, then take the test honestly: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Oya9G8f-i0Xo-MbTxW8BJK9wXU32CUA4/view
2. **Kolbe A and Working Genius** by Mon 26 Oct. I will send the links.
3. **Your 10-5-3-1 workbook** by Mon 26 Oct: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LL0AROYKrjyCB7zLI9AlG1PoEUzEAvqkCfKIcywijZM/edit
4. **Two conversations**, one with me and one with Nick, on Tue 27 and Wed 28 Oct.
5. **Two references**: please send me two people who have seen you work.

We will talk it through together on Fri 30 Oct. Reply with anything that does not work.

Kev

Notes for Kev: To (Kyle) is blank because no mail search tool was available this session. The one-pager footer reads 'Prepared for Kevin Hiebert Session': strip or regenerate before sharing. Confirm both Drive links are shared so Kyle can open them. Stipend deliberately not mentioned until Nick and Docket define it. Packet: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nXJZbCpLb0t3l_7HKCs5qv6owdH102CuP3145pdl8kc/edit
